# Third-party notices

`vis-network.min.js` is the standalone UMD distribution of **vis-network 9.1.6**, downloaded from
https://unpkg.com/vis-network@9.1.6/standalone/umd/vis-network.min.js.

vis-network is dual licensed under MIT or Apache-2.0; both upstream licence texts accompany this file. Its bundled
header retains dependency notices for included code. Preserve those notices in the library and generated HTML.
The generated HTML removes only the source-map URL so opening it does not request an external map.

The SHA-384 pin is in `../library.json`. This library requires no CDN connection at runtime.
